info.description:
This package contains the HTTP server, WebSocket handling, and API endpoints
for creating, monitoring, and interacting with thread pools in real-time.
info.title: provides the web UI backend for the Thread Pool Visualizer.

ApiKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyHeader.description: Primary API-key header. You can also send Authorization: Bearer <key>.

ApiKeyQuery.name: api_key
ApiKeyQuery.description: Alternative query parameter for browser and websocket flows.

post.description: This endpoint stops any currently running pool and creates a new one with the specified type and parameters.

parameters.description: The type of pool to create (e.g., "fixed", "cached").
parameters.name: pool_type

parameters.description: The number of workers for a fixed pool.
parameters.name: worker_count

parameters.description: The size of the task queue.
parameters.name: queue_size

parameters.description: The minimum number of workers for a dynamic pool.
parameters.name: min_workers

parameters.description: The maximum number of workers for a dynamic or cached pool.
parameters.name: max_workers

parameters.description: The configuration for the new pool.
parameters.name: PoolCreateRequest

post.description: This endpoint gracefully shuts down the active thread pool.

get.description: This endpoint returns a list of the names and descriptions of the thread pool implementations that can be created.

post.description: This endpoint submits a new task (or a batch of tasks) to the active pool for execution. delay_ms and cron_expression are supported when the active pool is scheduled. chain_dependencies links each task in a batch so each one starts after the previous completes.

parameters.description: The simulated duration of the task in milliseconds.
parameters.name: duration_ms

parameters.description: Whether the task should simulate a failure.
parameters.name: should_fail

parameters.description: The number of tasks to submit in this batch.
parameters.name: task_count

parameters.description: Delay before execution in milliseconds (scheduled pool only).
parameters.name: delay_ms

parameters.description: Cron expression for recurring tasks (scheduled pool only, 6-field format).
parameters.name: cron_expression

parameters.description: When true, each task in a batch depends on completion of the previous task.
parameters.name: chain_dependencies

parameters.description: The configuration for the new task(s).
parameters.name: TaskSubmitRequest

400.description: Invalid request body or no active pool
